inputs.name: inputData
inputs.label: Input (connect from node that may fail)

inputs.name: errorSource
inputs.label: Error Source Node ID (optional)
inputs.placeholder: Leave blank to catch errors from any upstream node

inputs.name: fallbackValue
inputs.label: Fallback Value (optional)
inputs.placeholder: Value to output if an error is caught — use {{variables}} or literal text

outputs.name: errorPath
outputs.label: Error Path
outputs.description: Activated when an error is caught.

outputs.name: successPath
outputs.label: Success Path
outputs.description: Activated when no error — passes data through.

outputs.name: errorMessage
outputs.label: Error Message
outputs.description: The error message from the failed node.

outputs.name: failedNodeId
outputs.label: Failed Node ID
outputs.description: The ID of the node that failed.

outputs.name: hasError
outputs.label: Has Error
outputs.description: True if an error was caught, false if data passed through cleanly.

outputs.name: fallbackValue
outputs.label: Fallback Value
outputs.description: The configured fallback value, if set.
